title: バレーボール部の場面
lead: サーブ・レシーブ・スパイク・ブロックなど、バレーボール部の練習と試合の場面12点です。部活動の案内や部員募集の資料に使えます。
subject_en: Hand-drawn loose-line style, each ONE volleyball scene with one to three players in plain team uniforms (no numbers, no logos), centred in its cell, energetic natural poses, simple faces. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a player tossing the ball up before a serve
a player diving low to receive the ball with joined arms
a setter pushing the ball up with both hands overhead
a player jumping high and striking the ball over the net
two players jumping with arms raised at the net to block
a player in a different coloured jersey sliding to save a ball
six players in a circle with arms around shoulders
two players high-fiving after a point
players lined up doing receive drills with a coach throwing balls
a team manager carrying a ball cart and a water bottle
a flip scoreboard with blank numbers beside a referee stand
players holding a trophy and a team flag overhead
